responsibility: Declares Alpha ELF driver-only options specific to the ELF toolchain integration, currently the relax option used in assembler and linker specs. This file exists so GCC’s option generator can recognize those ELF subtarget flags and thread them through driver/spec processing without placing them in the generic Alpha option table.
same_name_distinction: Within the elf stem, this is the Alpha ELF option-description file for driver-recognized flags such as relax, whereas elf.h contains the ELF subtarget's actual specs, assembler, and object-format macro customizations.
